name: cortico-world-opencode-quota
description: OpenCode Go 订阅额度监控：通过框架密钥隔离安全管理单/多把 API Key、支持已用/剩余双模式一键切换、内置可缩放月度趋势与虚线预测图、默认 piggyback 低打扰事件投递。
author: 云纪

zh.description: OpenCode Go 订阅额度监控面板与查询工具：通过 Cortico 框架安全存储（部署 .env）独立管理一把或多把 API Key 并自动去重，实时展示每 5 小时 / 每周 / 每月额度与重置倒计时，支持「剩余额度 / 已用额度」一键切换、可缩放月度趋势与虚线预测图，以及默认 piggyback 低打扰（五模式可配）事件投递。

en.description: OpenCode Go subscription allowance monitor: manages one or more API keys securely via Cortico deployment secrets (.env) with automatic deduplication, live 5-hour/weekly/monthly quota cards, one-click Remaining/Used display toggle, zoomable local monthly trend & dashed forecast charts, and quiet piggyback event delivery (all 5 Cortico trigger modes configurable).
